Project Title: Abandon Cart Email Series - PRAY.COM Premium Subscription
1. ✨ Overview & Purpose
Describe the overall purpose of this email template.
This is a 3-email automated sequence designed to re-engage users who initiated but didn't complete their PRAY.COM premium subscription purchase. The series will move from gentle reminder to value reinforcement to urgency/incentive.
Main goal: Recover abandoned subscription signups and convert free users to premium subscribers
Action: Complete subscription purchase and begin their premium spiritual journey
Type: Repeatable automation template triggered 1 hour, 24 hours, and 72 hours after cart abandonment
Guide users back to complete their subscription by reminding them of the transformative spiritual content awaiting them, while addressing common objections and creating gentle urgency.
2. 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Target Audience
Who is this email for?
Age range: 30-65 years old
Spiritual maturity: Spiritually curious to actively practicing Christians
Behavior: Already engaged enough to click into paywall but hesitated at purchase
Digital behavior: App users who are active but haven't converted to paid
Emotional state: Interested but uncertain, possibly experiencing decision paralysis or concern about commitment/cost
Likely objections: Price sensitivity, unsure of value, wanting to "think about it," technical issues during checkout
Faith-seeking individuals who have shown strong intent but need reassurance about the value, ease of cancellation, or a nudge to overcome inertia.
3. 📩 Email Type
✅ Automation (Cart Abandonment Sequence)
✅ Subscription promotions
Product Update (secondary)
4. 🧠 Subject Line Ideas
Email 1 (1 Hour): Gentle Reminder
"{{first_name}}, your spiritual journey is waiting ✨"
"You're so close to unlimited prayer & peace"
"Did something interrupt you? We saved your spot"
Email 2 (24 Hours): Value Reinforcement
"Here's what you'll unlock with PRAY Premium"
"Join 10M+ believers in daily prayer, {{first_name}}"
"Your faith journey deserves this 🙏"
Email 3 (72 Hours): Urgency + Incentive
"Last chance: Your exclusive offer expires soon"
"{{first_name}}, we held your discount ⏰"
"Don't miss out on your premium spiritual content"
5. ✉️ Preheader Text Ideas
Email 1:
"Complete your subscription in just 60 seconds and start your spiritual transformation today."
"We noticed you didn't finish. Your personalized prayer journey is one click away."
"Unlimited access to prayers, Bible stories, and sleep content awaits you."
Email 2:
"Discover why millions choose PRAY Premium for their daily faith walk."
"Ad-free prayers, exclusive content, and a thriving community of believers."
"Everything you need to deepen your relationship with God, in one app."
Email 3:
"This offer won't last—complete your subscription before it expires."
"Your special discount is waiting. Claim it now before time runs out."
"Final reminder: Start your premium journey today at this exclusive rate."
6. ✍️ Content (Copy)
EMAIL 1: Gentle Reminder (1 Hour After Abandonment)
Subject: You're so close to unlimited prayer & peace
 Preheader: Complete your subscription in just 60 seconds and start your spiritual transformation today.

Hi {{first_name}},
We noticed you started to join PRAY Premium but didn't complete your subscription. We wanted to make sure everything was okay!
Your spiritual journey is waiting for you.
With PRAY Premium, you'll unlock:
✨ Ad-free experience — Pray without interruption
 📖 10,000+ exclusive prayers & Bible stories — Fresh content daily
 😴 Sleep Bible stories & meditations — Rest in God's peace
 🎧 Offline listening — Take God's word anywhere
 🙏 Join 10M+ believers — You're not alone in your faith walk
Continue where you left off — it takes less than a minute.
[Complete My Subscription →]
Questions? We're here to help. Just reply to this email.
Walking with you in faith,
 The PRAY Team

P.S. Your cart is saved and ready whenever you are. No pressure—just peace, prayer, and purpose waiting for you.

EMAIL 2: Value Reinforcement (24 Hours After Abandonment)
Subject: Here's what you'll unlock with PRAY Premium
 Preheader: Discover why millions choose PRAY Premium for their daily faith walk.

Hi {{first_name}},
We understand—choosing to invest in your spiritual life is an important decision.
That's why we want to share what makes PRAY Premium so transformational for millions of believers around the world:
🎯 Personalized Daily Content
 Morning prayers, Scripture readings, and devotionals tailored to where you are in your faith journey.
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Content for the Whole Family
 Age-appropriate Bible stories and prayers for kids, teens, and adults. Grow together in faith.
⛪ Global Prayer Community
 Connect with believers worldwide. Share prayer requests, celebrate answered prayers, and support one another.
💤 Rest in His Peace
 Exclusive sleep stories narrated by beloved voices help you fall asleep to Scripture and wake refreshed.
📵 Zero Ads, Zero Distractions
 Just you and God. The way prayer should be.

"PRAY Premium has transformed my morning routine. I finally have the spiritual discipline I've been seeking for years."
 — Sarah M., PRAY Premium member

{{first_name}}, thousands join PRAY Premium every week because they know their spiritual growth is worth it.
You're worth it too.
[Start My Premium Journey →]
Try it risk-free: Cancel anytime in just two taps. No commitments, just spiritual growth.
Praying for you,
 The PRAY Team

EMAIL 3: Urgency + Incentive (72 Hours After Abandonment)
Subject: Last chance: Your exclusive offer expires soon
 Preheader: Your special discount is waiting. Claim it now before time runs out.

Hi {{first_name}},
This is it—your last reminder about the PRAY Premium subscription you started.
We've held a special offer just for you, but it expires in 24 hours.
⏰ After that, this rate goes away.
Here's what you'll miss if you don't act now:
❌ Ad-free prayer and meditation
 ❌ 10,000+ exclusive prayers & Bible stories
 ❌ Sleep Bible stories with celebrity narrators
 ❌ Offline access to take God's word anywhere
 ❌ A global community of 10M+ believers
You were just seconds away from starting your premium spiritual journey. Don't let this opportunity pass.
[Claim My Offer Now →]

Still not sure? Here's what our members say:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
 "Best decision I've made for my faith life. PRAY Premium keeps me grounded every single day."
 — Michael R.
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
 "My kids love the Bible stories, and I love the sleep meditations. Worth every penny."
 — Jennifer K.

{{first_name}}, we believe God is calling you to something deeper. Don't let another day go by without the spiritual nourishment you deserve.
Your offer expires in 24 hours. Complete your subscription now.
[Start My Journey Today →]
Still have questions? Reply to this email—we're here for you.
In faith,
 The PRAY Team

P.S. Remember: You can cancel anytime with zero hassle. We make it easy because we're confident you'll love PRAY Premium. But there's only one way to find out—and time is running out.
7. 🧩 Content Sections (Structure)
Email 1:
✅ Personalized greeting
✅ Gentle acknowledgment of abandonment
✅ Feature list (benefits overview)
✅ Primary CTA button (Complete My Subscription)
✅ Reassurance/support message
✅ P.S. with low-pressure reminder
✅ Footer (social icons, unsubscribe, preferences)
Email 2:
✅ Empathetic opening
✅ Detailed value propositions (icon + description format)
✅ Callout quote/testimonial
✅ Primary CTA button
✅ Risk-reversal statement (cancel anytime)
✅ Footer
Email 3:
✅ Urgency headline/messaging
✅ Scarcity element (24-hour expiration)
✅ "What you'll miss" list (FOMO)
✅ Social proof (star ratings + quotes)
✅ Primary CTA button (repeated)
✅ P.S. with final objection handling
✅ Footer
8. 🧵 Tone/Voice Notes
Email 1:
✅ Gentle
✅ Helpful
✅ Non-pushy
✅ Encouraging
Email 2:
✅ Hopeful
✅ Story-driven
✅ Faith-filled
✅ Community-focused
✅ Empowering
Email 3:
✅ Urgent (but not aggressive)
✅ Encouraging
✅ Motivational
✅ Direct
✅ Supportive
Overall Series: Progress from soft reminder → value education → respectful urgency. Always maintain warmth and spiritual authenticity. Never guilt-trip—inspire instead.
9. 🔗 Links
Email 1:
Primary CTA Button: "Complete My Subscription" → Direct to checkout page with cart pre-populated (use unique token)
Support link: "Reply to this email" → support@pray.com
Email 2:
Primary CTA Button: "Start My Premium Journey" → Checkout page
Secondary CTA (optional): "See All Premium Features" → Premium landing page
Cancel policy link: "Cancel anytime" → FAQ or terms page
Email 3:
Primary CTA Button: "Claim My Offer Now" → Checkout page with discount applied
Secondary CTA: "Start My Journey Today" → Checkout page (repeated lower in email)
Testimonials link (optional): "Read more reviews" → App Store/Google Play reviews or testimonials page
All Emails:
Social media icons → Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, YouTube
Unsubscribe/Preferences link → User email preferences center
10. 🗓 Timeline & Stakeholders
Automation Trigger Logic:
Email 1: 1 hour after cart abandonment
Email 2: 24 hours after cart abandonment (only if Email 1 not converted)
Email 3: 72 hours after cart abandonment (only if Email 2 not converted)
Exit automation: If user completes purchase at any point
Stakeholders:
Email Copywriter: Draft creation
Designer: Email template design
Product Manager: Checkout flow review & discount logic
Engineering: Automation setup, cart tracking, discount code implementation
Marketing Ops: QA testing, deployment, performance tracking
Timeline:
Draft Due: [Insert date]
Design Mockups: [Insert date - 3 days after draft]
Development/QA: [Insert date - 1 week after design]
Launch Date: [Insert date]
11. 📊 Success Metrics
Primary KPIs:
Cart Recovery Rate: Target 15-20% (industry benchmark: 10-15%)
Open Rate: Target 40%+ (Email 1), 35%+ (Email 2), 30%+ (Email 3)
Click-Through Rate: Target 8-12% across series
Conversion Rate: Target 5-8% per email (cumulative 15-20%)
Secondary KPIs:
Revenue recovered per email sent
Unsubscribe rate (monitor for below 0.5%)
Email-to-purchase time (faster = better user experience)
Lifetime value of recovered subscribers vs. organic signups
Optimization Tracking:
A/B test subject lines (urgency vs. benefit-focused)
Test CTA button copy variations
Test discount inclusion in Email 3 vs. no discount
Monitor device-specific performance (mobile vs. desktop abandonment/completion)
Success looks like:
Recovering 15-20% of abandoned carts
Maintaining brand warmth (low complaints/unsubscribes)
Creating repeatable, evergreen automation that generates consistent recurring revenue
Building trust with users who complete purchase after email nurture (track retention rates)
